objective.name: continuity_data
objective.description: Defines the content (substance) of a continuity header Matter: its identity, intentions, pilot reference, lineage and the reference to its journal. The durable message stream is not part of it: it lives in the journal Matter.

functional._id_note: Required. Stable identifier of the continuity.
functional._created_at_note: Required. Timestamp at which the continuity was created.
functional._parent_id_note: Optional. Identifier of the parent continuity. Null or absent for a root continuity.
functional._children_note: Required. Collection of identifiers of direct child continuities.
functional._initial_intention_note: Required and immutable. Founding direction of the continuity and persistent semantic reference for all later cognition.
functional._current_intention_note: Required. Current local direction of the continuity. Initially equal to initial_intention and explicitly updated when cognition changes direction.

pilot_ref._context_note: Absolute context path that owns the pilot: the context where the pilot_definition Matter lives (any context), or the context of the Capacity for a Capacity pilot.
pilot_ref._matter_id_note: Matter form only. Matter ID of the pilot_definition inside the addressed context. Exclusive with capacity.
pilot_ref._capacity_note: Capacity form only. Name of the Capacity whose plan decides for the continuity. Exclusive with matter_id.
pilot_ref._limits_note: Optional, Capacity form only. max_inferences_per_message lowers the default ceiling (100) of prompts allowed for one message; timeout_s bounds one turn of the Capacity (default 600). wait_timeout_s (default 3600) bounds the wait of a wait group for answers that never come. context_tokens (and, optionally, compaction_advised_ratio and compaction_required_ratio, as in a pilot_definition) lets agentic_core compute the context pressure of a Capacity pilot and give it to the plan; the succession stays the plan's decision.
pilot_ref._allowed_capacities_note: Optional, Capacity form only: the same patterns as in a pilot_definition (a pilot_definition carries its own).
pilot_ref._forbidden_capacities_note: Optional, Capacity form only: the same patterns as in a pilot_definition; they win over allowed_capacities.
pilot_ref._allowed_contexts_note: Optional, Capacity form only: the same as in a pilot_definition.
pilot_ref._forbidden_contexts_note: Optional, Capacity form only: the same as in a pilot_definition; they win over the allowed lists.

functional._pilot_ref_note: Required. Explicit reference to what decides for this continuity: a pilot_definition Matter { context, matter_id } or a Capacity { context, capacity, limits? }, never both.
functional._status_note: Required. active while the continuity can be activated; archived, read-only, once a successor continues it. A lineage has exactly one active continuity.
functional._lineage_id_note: Required. Identifier of the first continuity of the chain of successions this continuity belongs to; it is the identifier its delegating parent knows.
functional._generation_note: Required. Rank in the lineage: 1 for the first continuity, then incremented at each succession.
functional._predecessor_id_note: Optional. Identifier of the continuity this one continues. Absent for the first continuity of a lineage.
functional._successor_id_note: Optional. Identifier of the continuity that continues this one. Present if and only if status is archived.

journal_ref._context_note: Absolute context path that owns the journal Matter. Currently /root/agentic.
journal_ref._matter_id_note: Matter ID of the journal in that context (journal_<continuity id>).

functional._journal_ref_note: Required. Reference to the journal Matter holding the complete ordered immutable stream of durable messages of the continuity (JSON Lines, one message per line, canonical order = message.seq = line number). Written at creation and never modified. The messages are not part of this document.
